name: Lost Magical
source: Queen Tia decides to leave her country after her lover is taken from her. While on the run, she is attacked and knocked unconscious. When she comes to, she's in a dark, unfamiliar house. She finds herself growing closer to the owner of the house, unaware that pursuers are headed her way...
translation: 蒂亚女王在她的爱人被带走后决定离开她的国家。在逃跑过程中，她遭到袭击并被打昏。等她醒来的时候，发现自己身处一个陌生的黑暗房子里。她发现自己与屋主的距离越来越近，却没有意识到追捕者正在朝她走来……
